+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M4B42S72SRF2PEZR5603JKBR
+- 01M4B42JQ57AGYC98JP3AHG2CT
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: a780
+title: 'kanban CLI: execute, watch, schema'
+---
+## What
+The command line tool. The basis is plan.md §7.2 (CLI) and §6.7 (In the CLI).
+- `Sources/kanban/KanbanMain.swift` with swift-argument-parser:
+  - `kanban '<document>' [--variables <json>]`: run against the current directory; print the response JSON.
+  - `kanban watch '<subscription>'`: print one JSON line for each event until the user stops it (SIGINT ends the stream and calls `close()`).
+  - `kanban --schema`: print the generated SDL.
+- Exit code 0 for a response (also with GraphQL errors); a non-zero code only for an I/O fault or bad arguments.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `kanban '{ board { name } }'` in a temporary repo prints a response with the directory name.
+- [ ] `kanban --schema` prints SDL that has `type Task` and no `patch` field.
+- [ ] `kanban watch` prints one line for a commit made by a second process.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/CLI/KanbanCLITests.swift`: run the built `kanban` executable as a child process in a temporary repo.
+- [ ] Run `swift build && swift test --filter KanbanCLITests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: wballard
+  id: 01m4d6tyth8rh8qr56t7he57fp
+  text: |-
+    Research done.
+    - `Sources/kanban/KanbanMain.swift` has only a `ParsableCommand` with the usage text. Package.swift already has the `kanban` executable target with ArgumentParser 1.8.2.
+    - Public API for the CLI: `KanbanGraph(root:actor:)`, `execute`, `subscribe`, `close()`, `KanbanGraph.schemaSDL`, `KanbanArguments(_ content: GeneratedContent)` (public init; its fields are internal), `KanbanTool(graph:).call(arguments:)` (public; it gives `INVALID_VARIABLES` for bad variables text).
+    - ArgumentParser: `CommandConfiguration(subcommands:defaultSubcommand:)`. The parser falls back to the default subcommand when no subcommand name matches. The root must be `AsyncParsableCommand` so that `@main` runs the async `main()`. A `ValidationError` exits with `EX_USAGE` (64); another error exits with `EXIT_FAILURE`.
+    - The native build puts `kanban` next to `FoundationModelsKanbanTests.xctest` in `.build/debug` (`out/Products/Debug`).
+    - `Git.run` in `Identity/BoardKey.swift` reads both pipes to the end on serial queues (`PipeReader`, private). It cannot give the first line of a process that still runs, so `kanban watch` needs a reader that streams.
+    - Test helpers to reuse: `GitSandbox.makeRepo(named:origin:)`, `GitGraphFixture.makeGraph(at:mintingFrom:)`, `CrossRepoFixture.addTask(with:on:)`, `StreamWait.value(of:)`.

forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -11,6 +11,21 @@
     - `Git.run` in `Identity/BoardKey.swift` reads both pipes to the end on serial queues (`PipeReader`, private). It cannot give the first line of a process that still runs, so `kanban watch` needs a reader that streams.
     - Test helpers to reuse: `GitSandbox.makeRepo(named:origin:)`, `GitGraphFixture.makeGraph(at:mintingFrom:)`, `CrossRepoFixture.addTask(with:on:)`, `StreamWait.value(of:)`.
   timestamp: 2026-10-08T07:32:25.041220+00:00
+- actor: wballard
+  id: 01m4d7fkg0qcxfekv6ny8va66f
+  text: |-
+    Design choices that plan.md does not state:
+    1. The default subcommand has the name `run`. ArgumentParser needs a subcommand type for `defaultSubcommand`, so `kanban run '<document>'` also works. `kanban '<document>'` and `kanban --schema` go to `run`.
+    2. `kanban '<document>'` builds `KanbanArguments` from a `GeneratedContent` with the keys `query` and `variables`, and calls `KanbanTool(graph:).call(arguments:)`. Thus the library owns the decode of `--variables`. Text that is not one JSON object gives a response with `INVALID_VARIABLES` and the exit status 0 (plan.md §7.1). A subscription document through `run` gives `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_IN_TOOL`; `watch` is the path for a subscription.
+    3. `watch` has no `--variables` option, because plan.md §7.2 names none. It calls `subscribe` with no variables.
+    4. The root of the engine is the current directory as it is. The CLI does not search for the git top-level directory. The session actor is the OS user (`actor: nil`).
+    5. Bad arguments exit with `EX_USAGE` (64): no document and no `--schema`, a document together with `--schema`, and `--variables` without a document. An I/O fault (for example a directory that is not in a git repo) exits with `EXIT_FAILURE` (1).
+    6. SIGINT: `signal(SIGINT, SIG_IGN)` plus a `DispatchSource` signal source that feeds an `AsyncStream`. A child task of a task group waits for the first element and calls `graph.close()`; the close ends the subscription stream, and the command exits with 0. The output uses `FileHandle.standardOutput.write(contentsOf:)` with no buffer (and no `print`, which the lint rules forbid).
+    7. Test helper `CLI/KanbanProcess.swift`: it does not reuse `Git.run`. `PipeReader` is private and reads each pipe to its end, so it cannot give the first line of a `watch` run that still runs. The helper empties each pipe with a `readabilityHandler` into an `AsyncStream`, and each wait goes through `StreamWait` (10 s). `deinit` terminates a child that still runs. The executable is found next to the test bundle (`Bundle(for:)` → build products directory).
+    8. The `watch` test cannot know when the child subscribed, and a commit before the subscription gives no event. Thus a second `KanbanGraph` adds one task each 200 ms until the first line comes; each line is an event of a commit of the second engine.
+    9. Both `swift build --build-tests` and a plain `swift test` build the `kanban` product (checked: the binary was removed, and each command made it again).
+    10. TDD note: the test "document together with --schema is EX_USAGE" passed at RED, because the old binary rejected each argument. The other 7 tests failed on assertions. The test stays as a guard for the new validation.
+  timestamp: 2026-10-08T07:43:41.568881+00:00
 depends_on:
 - 01M4B42S72SRF2PEZR5603JKBR
 - 01M4B42JQ57AGYC98JP3AHG2CT
